node.statement: Let M be an arbitrary compact modern C^1 manifold. Node 1.1 can be instantiated only after an allowable Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead atlas on M has been established; node 1.2 can be instantiated only after M is known to be class-one and a finite allowable cover has been obtained. Node 1.3 says precisely that the allowed inputs establish neither the universal class-one identification nor the universal existence of such an allowable atlas. Thus the antecedents required to apply 1.1 and 1.2 to arbitrary M are absent. The former derivation is retracted, and no unconditional root conclusion follows from 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3.
